product: Fe I VIS ENGINE-A-3DNLTE, selector ASPLUND_AGSS21, n=21 (all 4 holdings)
premise_tested: '15 of 21 lines carry K07 (Kurucz semi-empirical) gf in our store'
premise_verdict: REFUTED — not one of the 21 carries the K07 tag
why: AGSS21 Table A.2 prints lambda to 1 dp in Angstroms (nanometres to 2 dp = 0.1 A resolution) while gf_grades.WAVE_TOL_A is 0.02 A. 15 lines sat 0.024-0.050 A from their own canonical_gf row — inside the printing's rounding bin, EP agreeing to better than 0.0005 eV — and missed the window. grade_line has no 'not found' verdict, so the miss fell through to the blanket Kurucz systematic and was LABELLED systematic:K07.
derived_tolerance_basis: half AGSS21 Table A.2's printed resolution: lambda is printed in NANOMETRES to 2 dp = 0.1 A, so half-width 0.05 A (RYA-1109)

controls.global_widening_refused_because: a GLOBAL 0.02 -> 0.06 A takes the canonical Fe I table's self-ambiguous rows from 26 to 210, so a pool stated at full precision must keep 0.02; the tolerance is a property of the SOURCE and is handed down per set

sigma_syst_unchanged_because: the MIXED-POOL rule binds either way: 5 of 21 lines are GF-LAB, and a pool is graded only if EVERY line is. 16 of the 21 have no primary-laboratory Fe I measurement in the repo AT ANY TOLERANCE — the lab census plateaus at 6/21 — so this is a real absence, not a lookup failure.
hypothetical_refused_because: 17/21 = 81% carry a citable per-line sigma, below gf_rung.CITED_COVERAGE_MIN = 90%. An RMS over part of a pool does not describe the pool. Reported as the size of the prize, NOT adopted.

agss21_gf_sources.Den Hartog et al. 2014: primary laboratory (FTS branching fractions x lifetimes)
agss21_gf_sources.Scott et al. 2015a: line SELECTION carried over, gf from the groups above
